'''Jedi outposts''' were satellite [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] facilities created by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. They were built after the Jedi [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|encountered]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] of the [[Sith Order]]. They were attacked and destroyed throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Kinect" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Attack" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jedi outposts appear in the Jedi Destiny portion of the [[2012]] Kinect-exclusive [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
